open_questions.gap: The objective is stated only as a 'successful launch' (RFP) with no measurable outcome, KPI or target; the kickoff says nothing is written down, and the email gives a launch-date rationale but no business objective.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Without a defined success measure we cannot set strategy, channel mix or how results will be judged.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Τι σημαίνει για εσάς «επιτυχημένο launch»; Υπάρχουν συγκεκριμένα KPIs ή στόχοι (π.χ. awareness, δοκιμές, πωλήσεις) και σε ποιο χρονικό διάστημα;

open_questions.gap: The primary goal was spoken as the collapsed phrase «μπραντ αγουέρνες»; the intended term is not confirmed (no glossary match).
open_questions.why_it_matters: The whole brief is built around this objective, so it must be the client's actual goal and not a transcription guess.
